serviceScopes.description: Native service subchart aliases; an empty scope means the first-party service chart itself.

units.description: Explicit service membership for each deployed release unit; omitted units and services are not deployed.

clusterResources.description: Explicit cluster-scoped resource kinds allowed in this environment's AppProject, in addition to its Environment composite.

scaledBy.description: Who owns replica counts. external: something outside Git (for example scheduled downscaling) changes them; Argo ignores them and Understudy baselines follow the live count. Defaults to git.

layers.description: Repository-relative values files applied to every service between its definition and the environment's own files, in order.

environment.description: Values for the environment chart, deployed and synchronized automatically. Requires the environment chart pin; the namespace comes from the environment.

vars.description: Promotion variables, available to gitValues paths and expressions as ${{ vars.<name> }}.

allowTags.description: Image-tag regular expression for this unit's Warehouse, overriding discovery.allowTags.

criteria.description: Freight creation criteria for this unit's Warehouse: a Kargo expression every new Freight must satisfy.

order.description: Service slot within the coordinated Application. Later slots wait for earlier services' after-jobs.

path.description: File in the repository at the promoted commit; may use ${{ vars.<name> }}.

expression.description: expr-lang expression selecting part of the parsed file; the whole file by default.

gitValues.description: Top-level values promoted from files in Git repositories at the Freight's commit; the Warehouse follows those repositories. The service's environment file becomes promotion-owned and is rewritten whole.

images.description: Values paths and the image repositories they promote. A digest field receives the digest; a tag field receives tag@digest for charts that render repository:tag. Keys must already exist in environment overrides. A unit without any is configuration: it syncs automatically and has no Kargo Freight slot.

capacityTargets.description: Exact Understudy-managed targets whose effective replicas Argo delegates. Must match service declarations; no unprotected targets.
